raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the question from the outset, framing the task as finding the end of a specific governor’s term for the city of death rather than recognizing that it asks when the office of “Governor” of that city ended. Since Pacem in Terris’ author (Pope John XXIII) died in the Vatican, the correct target is the year the office of Governor of Vatican City ended (1952). This misreading set all subsequent actions on the wrong path (hunting a person’s term end and vacillating over Rome vs. Vatican) instead of verifying the abolition year of the office.
